slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Area of a rectangle = base times height, A = bh. Area of a square of side s is s2.

For whole-number sides you can count unit squares: a 3 by 5 rectangle holds 3 rows of 5. We take A = bh as a postulate for all positive real lengths.

Area and perimeter are different: a 1 by 9 rectangle and a 3 by 3 square both have area 9, but perimeters 20 and 12. For a fixed perimeter, the square has the largest area of all rectangles.
